whatIsPrompt.question: What are Prompts and Workflows on ANS?
whatIsPrompt.answer: A prompt is a structured instruction for an AI model, while an ANS Workflow chains fact extraction, visual generation, and template rendering into a reusable pipeline so you can ship complete projects in minutes.

whyPromptsMatter.question: Why use structured workflows and studio tools?
whyPromptsMatter.answer:
Compared with ad-hoc chat prompts, structured studio workflows matter when:

• Building 3D personal websites, open-source README showcases, or AIGC storyboards with consistent layout quality
• Editing and previewing for free before confirming any paid model execution
• Exporting HTML and JSON drafts that you can tweak anytime without re-running paid tasks

whatIsPromptschat.question: What is ANS?
whatIsPromptschat.answer: ANS (AI Never Stops) is an AI co-creation and project delivery platform for students, builders, and developers—combining Project Explore, Workflow & Studio Market, VibeHub design knowledge, and Hackathon team compute grants.

howToUse.question: How do I start building my first project on ANS?
howToUse.answer: Browse Projects or the Market to pick a studio or workflow (such as the 3D Personal Website Studio), launch the interactive editor to customize text and camera stops for free, and export your HTML or sign in to save versions.

license.question: Who owns the resumes, websites, and workflows I create on ANS?
license.answer: You retain 100% ownership and copyright over your personal resumes, 3D personal websites, private workflows, and competition submissions. Public marketplace listings and open-source breakdowns follow the license specified by their authors—your personal work is never forced into the public domain.

selfHost.question: How do team competitions and compute grants work?
selfHost.answer: Visit Teams or Competitions to create or join a team. Once an event's compute window opens, the team owner can claim shared team compute credits for private workflow runs.

verification.question: How can I publish my own project to the Showcase or Explore?
verification.answer: Sign in and click '+ Submit Project' or visit the Community Hub to share your project highlights, live preview URL, or GitHub repository and earn community XP.

aiCredits.question: How do ANS compute points and refunds work?
aiCredits.answer: Manual text edits, preset switching, live previews, and HTML/JSON exports are completely free (0 points). Compute points are only reserved after you explicitly confirm a paid AI task (such as 3D avatar generation, four-view preparation, or AI copywriting) and are automatically refunded if an upstream task fails.

difference.question: Membership or points vouchers?
difference.answer: Top-up vouchers are fixed at ¥1 = 10 points (never expire). Membership plans grant a 1.21x–1.50x compute bonus (+21% to +50% extra points) plus workspace tools across learning, career and AIGC. Plans are in preparation; purchase and membership redemption are not available.

payment.question: Can I buy VibePlan now?
payment.answer: Not yet. Plans are in preparation, with no payment, automatic renewal or presale. See the points center for vouchers that are actually available.

announcements.question: What will be confirmed before launch?
announcements.answer: Plan pricing, periodic points, quota expiry and rollover, specific benefits, plus purchase, renewal and cancellation terms will be explained before availability.

ratio.question: Why do membership plans include 1.2x–1.5x more compute points than standard top-up vouchers?
ratio.answer: Standard top-up vouchers are fixed at ¥1 = 10 points (never expire). Membership plans keep their original price and grant a 1.21x–1.50x compute bonus: ¥19 Weekly includes 230 points (1.21x), ¥49 Monthly includes 650 points (1.33x), ¥129 Quarterly includes 1,800 points (1.40x), ¥49 Pro Weekly includes 600 points (1.22x), ¥129 Pro Monthly includes 1,800 points (1.40x), and ¥329 Pro Quarterly includes 4,950 points (1.50x). Plan points follow batch validity windows and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

expiry.question: When do points expire?
expiry.answer: Under the confirmed terms, top-up points do not expire. Weekly plan points last 14 days; each monthly or quarterly batch lasts 60 days. Quarterly grants arrive in three batches. Membership expiry does not remove points before their own expiry. These plan rules require batch management; existing top-up balances stay unchanged.

renewal.question: Will I be charged automatically?
renewal.answer: The first release uses LDXP term vouchers with manual renewal and no automatic charges. Same-tier renewal extends the term with scheduled grants. Upgrades show a price difference first; downgrades take effect next term. Exact upgrade calculations and refund handling must be ready before sale.

ownership.question: What happens to my work when membership ends?
ownership.answer: Ownership, basic privacy and export of existing work do not depend on membership. Saved text, source code and manual versions are not suddenly deleted at expiry. Large-media retention, archiving and traffic terms still need to be specified; permanent free hosting is not promised. Commercial use remains subject to asset and third-party licenses.

failure.question: How are failed tasks charged?
failure.answer: The intended rules require a budget before execution. Unsubmitted or duplicate requests are not charged twice; the platform covers duplicate consumption caused by its own faults. Failures already charged upstream are settled from actual receipts. An unsatisfactory result does not automatically make a rerun free. Consult the terms and cost shown before each task.

market.question: Can plan points buy market goods or be withdrawn?
market.answer: No. Plan and promotional points are limited to permitted personal compute, with no transfers, withdrawals or purchases of withdrawable goods. Seller income uses a separate CNY ledger. Market commission, escrow and settlement need their own implementation and are not sold as current plan benefits.
